dataset: Half continuous Unicode reply chunks; half alternating user rows and one ancient tool with distinct growing metadata fields/ranges. Bulk20 durable acknowledgements; every canonical row verified.

environment.cache: Fresh owner; OS page cache warmed by writes; no device cache flush
environment.build: Production TypeScript via tsx, not a packaged production daemon; no provider or browser process

phases.name: durable bulk append and derived projection
cold valid-index descriptors and bounded document/range reads

extrapolation.warning: Arithmetic size/row extrapolation only; tree height, key diversity and update pattern change growth. No 100k completion claim.

instrumentation: Successful public promises.fs open/writeFile and FileHandle write/writeFile/sync calls only; internal Node opens, failed wx dedup attempts and stream internals excluded. File blocks*512 is filesystem allocated space including node/directory overhead, not physical device write amplification. OS /proc phase deltas include metric reads. 25ms memory samples include harness.
